summary: Frontend-only non-regression sweep after adding <AdBanner /> to home (Aujourd'hui). CGU acceptance, email/password login (mobiletest123@aqua.com / Test1234!), and navigation across all 4 tabs verified on Expo web preview (390x844). Home renders fully after mounting AdBanner (which correctly returns null on web via AdBanner.web.tsx — no crash). All Premium-gated features still present (Aquanalyse score+tips, Aquacoach chat with free counter, Points d'eau locked screen). No JS errors, no red screen, zero pageerror events during the flow. AdBanner banner naturally absent on web preview (expected — native-only).
critical_code_review_comments: AdBanner.web.tsx correctly returns null → home mounts safely on web preview.

AdBanner.native.tsx guards Expo Go (Constants.appOwnership === 'expo') and require() try/catch → will not crash Expo Go either; ads only render in native release/dev-client build for non-premium users. This matches user expectation.

Non-regression PASS: no removed Premium features. Aquanalyse (score 0/100 + AI tips), Aquacoach chat with free-usage counter ("Vous avez utilisé vos messages gratuits"), and Water Points (wp-locked gate) all render correctly for the free test user.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing test account on deployed backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: (1) wait for CGU modal, click text 'J'ai compris et j'accepte'; (2) fill [data-testid=auth-email-input] and [data-testid=auth-password-input]; (3) click text 'Se connecter'. Aquanalyse AI insights take ~3–5 s to populate — wait accordingly before asserting [data-testid=insights-score] / [data-testid=insight-tip-0]. AdBanner is native-only; expect NO visible ad on web preview or Expo Go (this is correct — the web variant returns null by design).
rca_of_issue: User perception that Premium features were 'removed' is unfounded — verified all Premium screens still exist for the free user (locked/upsell states rendered as designed). Ads not visible on preview because AdMob is native-build-only; on web AdBanner.web.tsx renders null. Fix (mounting <AdBanner /> in app/(tabs)/index.tsx) is safe and does not crash the home screen.
flow_verified: Home: water-drop progress, quick-add (glass/cup/bottle/large_bottle/custom), today-waterpoints card, today's logs section, no crash after AdBanner mount
Progrès tab: insights-score + insight-tip-0 present after AI insight loads (~5s)
Aquacoach tab: coach chat + free counter visible
Profil tab: link-waterpoints → water-points screen → wp-locked gate
